title: Certification Frontiers for Gaussian LoRA: Independent Priors, Posterior Risk, and Prediction-Preserving Balancing
authors: Joyanta Jyoti Mondal, Ibne Farabi Shihab

authors: Joyanta Jyoti Mondal, Mridul Banik, Md. Shifatul Ahsan Apurba, Md Masud Al Mahmud
